**PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaltaalCubo2025#60554-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.information:
(BR) Bem-vindos ao segundo Unidavi ao Cubo (2025)
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

ATENÇÃO: Inscrições no local serão válidas apenas para o evento 3x3x3 e Pyraminx.

Pedimos também atenção ao fato de que quando cada pessoa for entrar na universidade será necessário fazer um cadastro rápido na portaria.
A universidade pede esse cadastro como medida de segurança.

(EN) Welcome to the second Unidavi ao Cubo (2025)
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events.

Also we want to point out that before each person gets in the university they will need to make a quick registration at the entrance.
The university demands this registration for safety standards.

(HR)

Croatian Championship 2025 je natjecanje koje se održava u Petrinji. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama.

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

----

(EN)

Croatian Championship 2025 is a competition held in Petrinja. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is recognized as Croatian National Championship and Top 3 Croatians in all events will be awarded.

For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTExNjcxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--18b4f661fc787a0b10e6192316ac1224d543eebc/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-07-16%20at%207.06.28%20AM.jpeg)
> Español:
¡Bienvenidos al MalecOpen Mazatlán 2025, la segunda competencia oficial en Sinaloa!

Con el icónico Malecón de Mazatlán como escenario, uno de los más largos y hermosos del mundo, este torneo promete una experiencia única frente al Pacífico. Competidores del noroeste mexicano y más allá se reunirán para disfrutar, aprender y demostrar su habilidad en distintas categorías.

El evento es organizado por Sinaloa SpeedCube Team, Team Nayarit y Baja Cubing, y está avalado por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Todos los participantes deben conocer el reglamento oficial antes del evento.

> English:
Welcome to MalecOpen Mazatlán 2025, the second official competition in the state of Sinaloa!

With the iconic Malecón of Mazatlán as its backdrop, one of the longest and most beautiful boardwalks in the world, this tournament offers a unique experience by the Pacific Ocean. Cubers from the northwestern region of Mexico and beyond will gather to compete, learn, and enjoy a variety of events.

This event is organized by Sinaloa SpeedCube Team, Team Nayarit, and Baja Cubing, and is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). All competitors must be familiar with the official regulations prior to the competition.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

All additional donations and remaining profits from this competition will go towards supporting West Coast Cubing and the Cal Cube Club.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may bring a maximum of two guests.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
